## Before you start {.study}

- **What you need:** a phone or a computer with a browser, a free Canva
  account (`canva.com`), PowerPoint (on a computer, on the web or the
  phone app), and your form and website (Online activities 10 and 11).
- **Time:** about 60 minutes. Work alone, at your own speed.
- **How it works:** read Steps 1–3, try each simulator and answer the
  questions: the page checks each answer at once. Then do the **Tasks to
  submit**.
- **This is the end of the course project:** you hand in the whole
  project: the form, the website, the post, the plan and three slides.
- **What you submit:** a picture, a PowerPoint file, two links and four
  letters, on the university e-learning platform, one week after lecture 11.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary call-to-action free-picture marketing-plan ai-use-statement >}}

## Step 1 · A product page and a post with an AI picture {.study}

**In Product Page Lab:** build the page of one product in an online store,
part by part. A good product page has a clear **name**, a real **photo**,
the **price**, a few **key facts** and a **button** (Add to cart, Book
now).

{{< sim file="sims/product-page-lab.html" poster="sims/product-page-lab.png" title="Product Page Lab: a page that sells" height="560" >}}

- A **post**: a picture, a few words and the **call to action**, made in
  **Canva** (Download as PNG).
- **The picture:** a free photo, or a picture made by an **AI image tool**
  (in Canva: **Apps › Magic Media**). **Check** an AI picture: the right
  product, no wrong words or letters, no strange hands or faces. Then write
  its source: *Image: made with AI* (or *Photo: Canva*).
- Never a picture from Google Images, never a company logo.

::: {.callout-note title="Model · A post of the college gym"}
The gym makes a post in Canva: the design *Open today*, the words *The gym
is open · Book now*, a free photo from Canva with the line *Photo: Canva*.
The screens below show how.
:::

**In a browser or the Canva app.** The orange numbers show where to tap.

::: {.screens}

![[1]{.step-n} Click **Share**, then **Download**. [2]{.step-n} Choose **PNG**. [3]{.step-n} Click **Download**.](images/canva-download-1.png)

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Pages and pictures"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Ask us|nothing"}
Which price line is good on a product page?
:   10 JD

    Why: Show the price: customers do not like to ask.

The AI picture of your cake shows the word "Cakse". What do you do?
:   make it again, or use a free photo

    Why: Check every AI picture before you use it.

What do you write under a picture made by AI?
:   Image: made with AI

    Why: Say honestly where the picture comes from.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · A short marketing plan {.study}

**In Plan Builder:** build Mona's plan for December, row by row. A short
**marketing plan** is one table of six rows: the **goal** (a number and a
time), the **audience**, the **message**, the **channels**, the
**budget** and the **measure** (what you count).

{{< sim file="sims/plan-builder.html" poster="sims/plan-builder.png" title="Plan Builder: a short marketing plan" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Plans"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="be the best|how nice it looks"}
Which goal is good?
:   30 orders in January

    Why: A number and a time: you can measure it.

What do you count to measure the plan?
:   the orders from the form

    Why: They show if you reach the goal.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · Three slides and the final submission {.study}

**In Project Checker:** check the project of Easy Print, part by part.
Then check yours: the form (a test response arrives), the site (published,
the button opens the form), the post (its source line) and the plan (a goal
with a number).

{{< sim file="sims/project-checker.html" poster="sims/project-checker.png" title="Project Checker: is every part ready?" height="440" >}}

- **Slide 1** (Title and Content): the service, the customer and the need.
- **Slide 2** (Two Content): a screenshot of the website and the link of
  the form.
- **Slide 3** (Two Content): the post and the goal of the plan, and the
  AI-use statement: *Ideas and the picture of the post: an AI tool;
  checked by me.*

**In PowerPoint (as in Online activity 5).** The orange numbers show where
to click.

::: {.screens}
![[1]{.step-n} Click **Home › New Slide**. [2]{.step-n} Choose the layout: **Title and Content**, then **Two Content**.](../week-04/images/ppt-newslide-1.png)

![[1]{.step-n} Click **Insert**, then [2]{.step-n} **Pictures**, then [3]{.step-n} **This Device** for your screenshot and your post.](../week-04/images/ppt-picture-1.png)
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · The project"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="slide 4|delete the site"}
The screenshot of your website and the link of the form go on …
:   slide 2

    Why: Slide 2 shows how the service works.

The site opens only on your laptop. What do you do?
:   Publish

    Why: Only a published site opens for everybody.
:::
:::

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

### Task 1 · The post of your service

In Canva, make a post with the words of your service, a picture (an AI
picture that you checked, or a free photo) and its source line; download
a PNG (Step 1). **A** *Quiet room for group study · Book now* · **B** *Your
notes printed by tomorrow · Order now* · **C** *A new phone screen in one
day · Book now* · **D** *Healthy lunch for 2 JD · Order now*.

### Task 2 · The marketing plan (Step 2)

a) The goal: **A** 20 orders or bookings this month · **B** be famous

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The channel: **A** a poster in another city · **B** social media and
the college e-mail

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) The measure: **A** how nice the post looks · **B** the responses of the
form

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

### Task 3 · The final submission (Step 3)

Make `project.pptx` (three slides). Paste the link of your form and the
web address of your site:

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

Did an AI tool help you? **A** yes: the AI-use statement is on slide 3 ·
**B** no

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## How to submit

Upload the PNG, `project.pptx`, the links and the letters, **one week
after lecture 11**.
